title: What do you think of my geometric Top-Down adventure prototypes? (Made with AI assistance)
author: Excellent_Profile_29
selftext:
>Hi everyone! I wanted to share my two geometric Top-Down game prototypes. It took me around 12 days of hard work to develop both using AI assistance alongside heavy manual coding, debugging, and balance tweaks.

The best part? **Both games run directly in your browser (HTML) with just one click!** I also just pushed a recent update that fully fixed the white-screen crash on startup, so stability is now at 100%.

Here is what you will find in each prototype:

🌌 1. Guardianes del Cosmos (2D RTS + Top-Down Shooter)

A chaotic and tactical real-time strategy game combined with top-down shooting mechanics. You control an entire empire, deploy custom fleets, and fight for galactic dominance.

* **Faction Creator:** Design your own empire from scratch, customizing aesthetics, weapons, and fleet composition.
* **Capture & Recruit System:** Capture enemy leaders and champions mid-combat to break their will and summon them to fight for your faction.
* **Permanent Loss Risk:** If enemies conquer an allied planet holding your captured champions, a 3-day real-time countdown begins to rescue them. If you fail, they are lost forever.
* **Game Modes:** Includes a narrative Campaign, an open Sandbox mode, and Instant Battles. (The HTML demo gives you a 10-minute preview of the Campaign and Tutorial).

🧟 2. Guardianes vs Zombies: Machine of Gore (Top-Down Tower Defense)

A classic, fast-paced tactical Tower Defense experience. Your goal is to survive waves of incoming zombies by placing fixed defenses on the map and managing your reflexes.

* **Immediate Tactical Action:** Fluid combat optimized to run perfectly on any browser or PC setup.
* **Multiple Game Modes:** Features a Campaign mode to test your endurance, a Chaos mode to play at the limit, and a Bandits Battle mode where you must be the last survivor standing.

I really want to know your thoughts on the gameplay loop, the browser optimization, and the overall mechanics. Any feedback from this community is highly appreciated!
